name: Representation cost and next query
query: Understand how one can compare representations and reasoning procedures that trade information preservation, abstraction, and computational cost. I need rigorous frameworks in which loss of distinctions and the selection of a next query can be justified at equal total resource cost, and information-preserving relabeling is distinguished from a genuinely new discriminative capability. Clarify the assumptions and impossibility or identifiability limits of a universal complexity or cost measure.

name: Missingness mechanisms and provenance
query: Determine when recording reasons for missing data and provenance of those reasons yields predictive or decision information beyond a binary missingness indicator, and how this advantage can be tested without information leakage or unequal model capacity. I need empirical and theoretical work that distinguishes mechanism information from general feature capacity, including conditions under which nonignorable missingness cannot be identified from observed data alone.

name: Identifiable phase and branch information
query: Determine how to design a learning or signal-processing task that makes phase or branch-sign information uniquely useful when the compared methods differ only in access to that information and have equal data, preprocessing, and total computational resources. Distinguish information loss and recoverability from optimization artifacts and nuisance phase or frequency offsets. Establish conditions under which a redundant representation cannot improve the information available to an optimal decision rule although it may help finite-budget learning.

name: metacognition
query: Internally generated affective or evaluative signals can become learned regulatory representations used to monitor one's own cognition in the absence of new external feedback. We distinguish a stored label from causal use of the label in metacognitive computation, and investigate how introspective signals generalize to new tasks while behavioral decisions may remain unchanged.

name: topological_index
query: The sum of local indices of zeros of a tangent vector field on a compact manifold equals its Euler characteristic under precise regularity and boundary conditions. In applications to dynamical state spaces the topology of a sphere or torus is distinguished by invariants and vector field structure rather than by matching polynomial expressions.

name: heavy_tail_edgeworth
query: Stable laws with infinite variance require a generalized central limit theorem rather than normalization by finite second moments. Edgeworth expansions describe the first non-Gaussian skewness correction under explicit moment and regularity conditions, which fail for many heavy-tailed distributions.

name: padic
query: An ultrametric defines a hierarchical state space in which digitwise p-adic precision determines distinguishability at a chosen scale. The distinction between a p-adic field for prime p and an adic ring for composite base is essential, and operational claims must specify the metric, channel noise and observable rather than infer a cognitive hierarchy from number representations alone.

name: diagonal
query: Self-reference and diagonal arguments require an explicit encoding of maps, an evaluation map and an endomorphism without fixed points. The categorical fixed point theorem unifies Cantor and Godel arguments but does not make every finite hierarchy incomplete or force an untyped higher-level operator.

name: symmetry
query: Elementary symmetric polynomials identify unordered roots of a polynomial and forget the ordering of the roots. Quotienting by a permutation group requires an explicit group action and invariant map, while symmetric roots of unity alone do not establish a recursive semantic hierarchy.

name: fluency
query: Processing fluency, confidence and subjective familiarity can influence judgments without increasing objective accuracy. Interventions can dissociate metacognitive report from decision performance, and task-dependent learned interpretations of ease prevent equating faster expectation with a universally more fundamental representation.

name: stable_aggregation
query: Sums of independent identically distributed random variables with regularly varying tails converge under appropriate centering and normalization to an alpha-stable law. Infinite variance changes the limiting law and scaling but does not preclude a well-defined distributional aggregation.

name: metareasoning
query: The expected value of a computation is its expected improvement in the final decision utility minus its computational cost. Metareasoning chooses which computational actions or observations to perform under limited resources and includes the overhead of deciding how to deliberate.
